answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as a ferrous commitment to network integrity. Acting as a lantern to illuminate malicious behavior, this staking model imposes a prohibitive financial penalty on bad actors. Much like sorting yarrow stalks to determine a pattern, the protocol filters identities through capital cost, ensuring that an attacker must acquire significant economic resources to overwhelm the consensus, rendering sybil creation fiscally irrational.
